summary: Gorilla Technology Group filed a Form 6-K disclosing a securities purchase agreement, dated October 29, 2026, with an institutional investor for senior convertible notes issued at original issue discount, up to $111.1 million principal (up to $100 million funding), plus Series D warrants and pre-delivery shares. The initial closing comprised a $27,775,000 note ($25 million funded), 850,612 warrants at $12.8995 and 1,000,000 pre-delivery shares for $1,000. Notes are non-interest-bearing, mature October 29, 2027, convert at $17.5308 fixed or a 90% VWAP alternative subject to a $6 million monthly cap and $3.858 floor. This is a routine financing, not a special situation; watch dilution and registration deadlines.
